ayahs.1: Alif-Lam-Mim — opening a surah about defeat, hope, and signs in creation.
ayahs.3: in the nearest land — yet after their defeat they will triumph
ayahs.4: within three to nine years. The matter rests with Allah before and after. On that day the believers will rejoice
ayahs.5: at the victory Allah wills. He gives victory to whom He wills. He is the Almighty, the Rahim.
ayahs.6: That is Allah's promise. Allah never fails His promise — yet most people do not know.
ayahs.7: They know only outward affairs of this dunya while they are heedless of the Akhirah.
ayahs.8: Have they not reflected on themselves? Allah created the heavens and earth and everything between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet most reject meeting their Rabb.
ayahs.9: Have they not travelled the land and seen the end of those before them? They were mightier, cultivated the land, and developed it more. Their messengers came with clear proofs. Allah did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
ayahs.10: Then the worst end was for those who denied and mocked Allah's signs.
ayahs.11: Allah originates creation and will resurrect it. Then to Him you will all be returned.
ayahs.12: On the Day the Hour arrives, the wicked will be struck dumb.
ayahs.13: No intercessors from their associate-gods, and they will deny those associates entirely.
ayahs.14: On the Day the Hour arrives, people will be split into two groups.
ayahs.15: Those who believed and did good will rejoice in a Garden.
ayahs.16: Those who rejected the truth, denied Our signs and meeting in the Akhirah — they will remain in punishment.
ayahs.17: So glorify Allah evening and morning —
ayahs.18: praise belongs to Him in the heavens and earth — and in the afternoon and at noon.
ayahs.19: He brings the living from the dead and the dead from the living. He gives life to earth after its death — and so you will be brought forth from the grave.
ayahs.20: One of His signs: He created you from dust, then you are humans spreading over the earth.
ayahs.21: One of His signs: He created for you spouses from yourselves so you find comfort in them. He placed compassion and mercy between you. In that are signs for people who reflect.
ayahs.22: One of His signs: creation of heavens and earth, and diversity of your languages and colours. In that are signs for people of knowledge.
ayahs.23: One of His signs: your sleep by night and day for rest, and your seeking of His bounty. In that are signs for people who listen.
ayahs.24: One of His signs: He shows you lightning, stirring hope and fear, and sends rain from the sky, reviving earth after death. In that are signs for people who understand.
ayahs.25: One of His signs: heavens and earth stand by His command. When He calls you once from the earth, you will emerge at once.
ayahs.26: To Him belong all in the heavens and earth — all are subject to His will.
ayahs.27: He originates creation then will resurrect it — easier for Him. To Him belong the finest attributes in the heavens and earth. He is the Almighty, All-Wise.
ayahs.28: He gives you an example from your own lives: would you make those under your care equal partners in wealth We gave you, honouring them as you honour peers? This is how We clarify signs for people who understand.
ayahs.29: Wrongdoers follow desire without knowledge. Who can guide those Allah leaves astray? They have no helpers.
ayahs.30: So stand firm in upright iman, O Prophet — the natural way Allah instilled in people. Do not alter Allah's creation. That is the Sirat al-Mustaqim — the way of living that pleases Allah — though most do not know.
ayahs.31: O believers, turn to Him, live with taqwa, and establish salah. Do not commit shirk —
ayahs.32: like those who split their deen into sects, each rejoicing in what they have.
ayahs.33: When hardship touches people, they call to their Rabb alone. When He gives a taste of mercy, some associate others with their Rabb again,
ayahs.34: ungrateful for what We gave. Enjoy awhile — soon you will know.
ayahs.35: Or did We send them authority proving what they associate?
ayahs.36: If We give people a taste of mercy, they grow proud. If evil afflicts them for what their hands did, they fall into despair.
ayahs.37: Have they not seen that Allah gives abundant or limited provision to whom He wills? In that are signs for people who believe.
ayahs.38: Give close relatives their due, and the poor and the traveller. That is best for those seeking Allah's pleasure — they will succeed.
ayahs.39: Whatever you give seeking interest at people's expense will not increase with Allah. Whatever charity you give seeking Allah's pleasure — their reward will be multiplied.
ayahs.40: Allah created you, provides for you, will cause you to die, then revive you. Can any associate-god do any of that? Exalted is He above what they associate.
ayahs.41: Corruption has spread on land and sea because of what people's hands earned, so Allah may let them taste some consequences and perhaps they will return.
ayahs.42: Say, O Prophet: Travel the land and see the end of those before you — most associated partners with Allah.
ayahs.43: So stand firm in upright faith, O Prophet, before a Day from Allah that cannot be turned back. On that Day people will be divided:
ayahs.44: those who rejected the truth will bear their rejection; those who did good will have prepared homes —
ayahs.45: so He may generously reward believers who did good from His grace. He does not love those who reject the truth.
ayahs.46: One of His signs: He sends winds bringing good news of rain, gives you a taste of His mercy, lets ships sail by His command, and lets you seek His bounty — perhaps you will show shukr.
ayahs.47: We sent before you messengers to their peoples with clear proofs. We punished those who persisted in wickedness. It is Our duty to help believers.
ayahs.48: Allah sends winds that stir clouds, spreads or piles them as He wills, and you see rain emerge. When He causes it to fall on servants He chooses, they rejoice
ayahs.49: though moments before they had lost all hope.
ayahs.50: See the effect of Allah's mercy: how He revives earth after death. That same One can raise the dead. He is Most Capable of everything.
ayahs.51: If We send a harsh wind and they see crops wither, they deny old favours at once.
ayahs.52: You cannot make the dead hear truth, nor make the deaf hear the call when they turn away.
ayahs.53: Nor guide the blind out of misguidance. You can make none hear except those who believe in Our ayahs, fully submitting.
ayahs.54: Allah created you weak, then gave strength after weakness, then weakness and old age after strength. He creates what He wills. He is All-Knowing, Most Capable.
ayahs.55: On the Day the Hour arrives, the wicked will swear they stayed in this dunya only an hour — so they were always deluded.
ayahs.56: Those gifted with knowledge and iman will say: You stayed as Allah destined until the Day of Resurrection. Here is the Day you denied — you did not know.
ayahs.57: On that Day wrongdoers' excuses will not benefit them, nor will they be allowed to appease.
ayahs.58: We set forth every kind of lesson in this Quran. Whatever sign you bring, those who reject the truth will say to believers: You are only people of falsehood.
ayahs.59: This is how Allah seals hearts of those unwilling to know.
ayahs.60: So bear sabr — the promise of Allah is true. Do not be disturbed by those without sure iman.
